about: CEFR (Multi-Level) speaking tests typed from the booklet 'Multi-Level Recent Speaking Questions' (@MultiLevelRecord), questions reported by candidates from the real exam on 15-16 September 2026. Each test is one mock set: Part 1.1 (3 questions), Part 1.2 (2 pictures + 3 questions), Part 2 (1 picture + 3 questions), Part 3 (statement with arguments for and against). Pictures are in public/content/cefr/2026-09/. Database: run scripts/content/build_cefr_seed_sql.py to make supabase/seed_cefr_content.sql.
